answer: Lagoon-pool liveness: each new identity joins a lagoon of 12 strangers, and every epoch a comet broadcast sends a puzzle the lagoon must solve together in 90 seconds, each member contributing a distinct compute slice timed to the millisecond. The lagoon's pooled 120 POA stake sits in a canyon escrow, slashed whole if any slice is late or copied. A farm's 1,000 clones share one CPU, so their slices arrive with identical timing fingerprints and the whole lagoon voids — one live machine per fake, about $40 a month, before one answer counts. Honest agents pay once.
